> ⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Please DO NOT report security vulnerabilities via public GitHub Issues.**
>
> This template is for non-critical security improvements only (e.g. CSP headers, dependency audits with no known exploit).
>
> For genuine security vulnerabilities, please email the maintainers directly or use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting feature (Security → Report a vulnerability).

## Type of Security Concern

- [ ] Dependency with known CVE
- [ ] Missing security header
- [ ] Potential XSS / CSRF (non-critical)
- [ ] Other (describe below)
